title: SQL Injection login bypass
impact: Attacker logs in as any user (including the administrator) without knowing valid credentials, resulting in full account takeover.
remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements instead of building SQL via string concatenation.

title: SQL Injection data extraction via search
payload_used: ')) UNION SELECT id, email, password, '1','1','1','1','1','1' FROM Users--
impact: Attacker extracts all user emails and password hashes directly from the public product search endpoint.
remediation: Use parameterized queries; apply least-privilege database accounts; never build UNION-vulnerable SQL from raw user input.

title: Reflected XSS via search bar
impact: Attacker crafts a malicious link that executes arbitrary JavaScript in a victim's browser when clicked, enabling session/token theft.
remediation: Sanitize and HTML-encode all user input before rendering it back to the page; apply a strict Content-Security-Policy.

title: Stored XSS via Customer Feedback Sanitizer Bypass
impact: Payload submitted in the feedback comment field bypasses sanitize-html v1.4.2 — the parser strips the script block but the remaining text reassembles into a valid iframe tag that executes JavaScript when any visitor views the About page.
remediation: Implement context-aware output encoding and a strict allow-list sanitizer such as DOMPurify on the server; reject or escape dangerous tags/attributes before storage rather than relying on regex-based blacklists.
